name: Neighbourhood Street
layout: Quiet residential streets connecting home, school, and the side alley that leads to the mysterious shop. Mix of two-story homes, utility poles, modest shops, and narrow turnoffs. A recurring main street plus one 'never-noticed' side street.
key_landmarks: Art festival poster wall / board early in story
Narrow side street canyon leading to the shop
Alley used for Unfinished sighting and return
furniture_objects: Planters / potted plants at house fronts
visual_identifiers: Lived-in residential calm; not a mega-city skyline
Soft daylight for ordinary travel; evening streetlights for late walk
Ink scuff marks appear only after Unfinished escapes, then fade after climax
Side street feels slightly 'between pages'—quieter, narrower, odd angle of light—but still real
camera_possibilities: Tracking walk shots behind or beside Kaito
Wide silhouette reveal for midpoint Unfinished
Close on ink marks on fence/wall
Night two-shot under streetlights for resolution walk
continuity_constraints: Route logic: bedroom/home area ↔ streets ↔ school; side street ↔ mysterious shop
Shop side street should remain findable after first discovery (not randomly teleporting)
Ink marks continuity: none before page ~29; present through chase; fade by page 43
Keep architecture consistent enough that readers recognize return locations
Do not densify into downtown skyscrapers mid-volume
